summary: iter135 verification: POST /api/team now accepts type='sous_traitant' with no email (backend 7/7 pytest pass, auth playbook regression 5/5 pass). Frontend 'Ajouter' button is correctly enabled with name only and shows the 'ajouté comme sous-traitant (sans compte)' toast. HOWEVER the created no-email sous-traitant NEVER appears in the 'Sous-traitants' list (before or after reload) because useTeam derives sousTraitants from GET /users filtered on role==='sous_traitant', while the no-email path writes to team_members. Email-based paths (new account with temp password panel, existing-user promotion) work correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Add sous-traitant without email (Users page > Sous-traitants block)
integration_issues.issue: Creation succeeds (POST /api/team 200, success toast) but the member is invisible in the UI: the Sous-traitants list and counter do not include it, even after a full page reload. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/useTeam.js line 17-27 builds sousTraitants only from GET /users (role==='sous_traitant') and never reads GET /team?type=sous_traitant. The user-reported feature is therefore only half fixed - an admin cannot see the sous-traitant he just added.

action_items: Fix useTeam.js to merge GET /team?type=sous_traitant (account-less members) with users having role 'sous_traitant', de-duplicating by name/email, so no-email sous-traitants show up in the list and counter.

Ensure the remove ('X') action in SousTraitantList handles account-less members: it currently calls PUT /users/{id} which will 404 for a team_members id - it must call DELETE /team/{id} for those entries.
Decide/implement where account-less sous-traitants are usable downstream (chantiers/planning assignment) - today they only exist in team_members and are referenced nowhere else in the frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: Two sources of truth for sous-traitants (users.role vs team_members.type) with no reconciliation; the no-email creation path silently produces orphan records.
SousTraitantList.removeRole() assumes every listed member is a user account (PUT /users/{id}); will break once team_members-sourced entries are rendered.

POST /api/team does not create a matching user, and POST /users (email path) does not create a matching team_member -> duplicates are possible if the same person is added both ways (no cross-collection duplicate check).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_QA_ST_UI1 (team_member), TEST_QA_ST_UI3 user (test-st-qa3@keylot.example.com); TEST_Tech2_QA was temporarily promoted to sous_traitant then reverted to technicien. All cleaned up via /app/backend/tests/_cleanup_iter135.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests for this feature: /app/backend/tests/test_iter135_sous_traitant.py (7 pass, covers no-email create, duplicate 400, invalid type 400/422, blank name, email persist, delete, non-admin 403). UI reproduction: login -> /utilisateurs -> data-testid team-sous-traitant-input + team-sous-traitant-add-btn. Note pytest.ini forces xdist; do not pass -p no:xdist. Use domain @keylot.example.com for test emails (@*.test is rejected 422 by email validator).
rca_of_the_issue: iter135 added 'sous_traitant' to the POST /api/team type Literal and routed the no-email frontend path to /team, but the display layer (useTeam.js) still lists sous-traitants exclusively from GET /users role==='sous_traitant'. Records created in team_members are thus never fetched, so the list stays unchanged and the badge counter does not increment despite the success toast.
